certification.name: GIAC Experienced Cybersecurity Specialist
certification.description: Applied Knowledge exam of 25 CyberLive hands-on challenges in four hours, open book, covering network security analysis, Windows and Linux security evaluation, security tools and common attacks and defenses. Counts toward the GSE portfolio.
certification.currency_note: Applied Knowledge exam; $499 for holders of the corresponding active base Practitioner certification (GSEC is the audience named on the page)
